arguments.decision_needed: Tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, from their own web search, cannot be fixed. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine, (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one, (3) what should happen to your existing machine (inspect, repair, dispose), or would you rather we send our contractor to inspect it first?
